tables.title: OPAMP internal input/output signals
tables.text: Table 181, "OPAMP internal input/output signals", in section 24.4.2 (OPAMP pins and internal signals) on page 729. Columns: Name, Type, Description. 5 data row(s).

opamp_tc3
opamp_tc4
opamp_tc5
opamp_tc6
opamp_tc7

Signal from a timer channel, selectable as control signal switching 
between primary and secondary controls for the input multiplexers.

opamp_tp1
opamp_tp2
opamp_tp3
opamp_tp4
opamp_tp5
opamp_tp6
opamp_tp7

Signal from a timer channel, selectable as control signal switching 
between primary and secondary controls for the programmable gain 
and for setting the PGA flavor.

Output of a DAC channel, selectable as noninverting operational 
amplifier input. Exclusive with the OPAMP_VINP3 pin.

Operational amplifier output to an internal COMP channel, when 
redirected through the OPAINTOEN bit.
